description: This file defines functions for directory and file operations such as recursive copying, directory creation and removal, file searching, and some debugging utilities. It also includes license and project information related to SugarCRM and SuiteCRM.

methods.name: copy_recursive
methods.description: Recursively copies files and directories from source to destination, cleaning cache for PHP files.

methods.name: mkdir_recursive
methods.description: Recursively creates directories, handling existing files and platform-specific path nuances.

methods.name: findTextFiles
methods.description: Finds text files with specific MIME types within a directory.

methods.name: getBacktraceString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current backtrace for debugging.

methods.name: findAllFiles
methods.description: Recursively finds all files, optionally matching an extension, with exclude capabilities.

methods.name: findAllFilesRelative
methods.description: Finds all files within a directory relative to current working directory.

methods.name: findAllTouchedFiles
methods.description: Finds files modified after a certain date.
